text:
sam: found this in the configs under /infra — YAML haunted house + semver meltdown 😬

sam: ```yaml
version: "1..0"
service:
  name: api
  replicas: 3
  env:
    - NAME: production
``` 

jen: oh noooo, who edited semver with a spaghetti fork? :spaghetti:

mike: "1..0" is my favorite flavor of invalid. :joy:

alex: semver-lint to the rescue? or do we invoke the ritual?

sam: tempted to open a PR titled "fixes everything" and hope for the best :tm:

deploy-bot: build failed — invalid-version: "1..0" at infra/manifest.yml:1

jen: also the YAML has mixed indentation (2 + 4) — it senses chaos

mike: can we blame the office plant? :potted_plant: it was last seen near the keyboard

alex: poll: tabs for life? raise hands. I'm team spaces but I acknowledge the tab cult.

jen: quick patch: `sed -E 's/1\.\.0/1.0.0/' infra/manifest.yml && git commit -m "fix: normalize semver and indent"`

sam: merging and crossing fingers. :crossed_fingers: if the compile gremlins show up, snacks will be provided

mike: snacks > compile gremlins. Always.

alex: thanks for the giggle, team — five minute break for office plant therapy :herb:
